purpose: Slicer scripted module for planning ablation probe placement. Users place fiducial pairs to position copies of a vendor ablation-zone segmentation, then compute signed margin distances to a tumor segmentation using ModelToModelDistance. It is aimed at interventional radiology research.
summary: I read the full module Python file, the CMake files, the catalog entry, the README and the license. I found no network access beyond the standard Slicer sample-data registration. I found no package installs, no subprocess or eval use, and no data exfiltration. The license is the Slicer BSD-style license, and the README carries a research-only disclaimer. The catalog entry is usable, and its build dependency matches EXTENSION_DEPENDS. The problems are ordinary quality ones. The module deletes every Markups Line node in the scene, makes a global 3D-view change at setup, has a few latent bugs, uses a branch reference as the revision, and has weak tests and sample data. None of these block admission. 🟢 Recommend merge.
